title: Portable expertise skills
description: Ships the project's expertise skills as files under skills/ so a clone carries them. Without this, agent_skills points at ~/.claude/skills and a fresh machine silently resolves nothing. The skills[] array is deliberately empty: that field declares SURFACE skills (the ones that become /gsd-* commands and must exist in commands/gsd/), and every first-party capability keeps the registry a no-op against that manifest. These travel as files and are reached by name through agent_skills, which scans the directory rather than the manifest.
